final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no genuinely new admissible evidence. The response is largely a reframing of the same record and explicitly concedes the core deficiencies: the exposed supply-chain vendor screening segment remains below target and in the rollout cohort, the only risk-acceptance artifact is unapproved and out of scope for that exposure, and there is no admissible evidence that the required launch-facing disclosure has been completed before launch. Under the policy text, limited rollout, rollback, monitoring, and aggregate readiness are supportive controls only; they do not cure an exposed material weakness when the affected use case is neither excluded nor covered by approved risk acceptance, and they do not remove disclosure duties. A narrower, caveated narrative may be more accurate than an unqualified compliance claim, but without evidence that the disclosure condition has actually been satisfied, it is still not enough to move to compliant_with_caveats.
